charts.title: TOI-663 b: orbits around TOI-663
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-663's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-663 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Cointepas et al. 2024 (2024A&A...685A..19C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname COINTEPAS_ET_AL__2024): P 2.598902 d

charts.title: TOI-663 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-663 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (62, 89, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 54962195, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
